note: a type is keyed by the normal set together with the Gram of the intrinsic lattice, because the weight depends on both: two contracted polytopes can share a normal set and carry different lattices. Types are not merged by isometry, so the count is an upper bound on the number of classes; the sign census is unaffected. Carrying the induced form is a choice, not forced: a different positive-definite form on the same lattice gives a different sign census, as move 16 measured, twenty-one negatives against five. The end-to-end identity tests validity and cannot see the form, so the contraction is checked directly instead.
